method: Compare a common text-free picture strip in every decoded delivery frame against the original source at its sample-and-hold timestamp. Reduce each strip to 64×8 grayscale; allow up to 15 mean absolute levels for scaling, compression and the light landscape shade, and require at least 65% of source mean brightness when the source is nonblack.
limits: Detects absent, substantially wrong or mis-timed sampled picture content. This strip check is not full-frame pixel equivalence and cannot establish physical-browser or audio latency. Separate decoded-frame inspection covers the complete composition.
